jobs.title: Join our expanding ERP Advisory Team - Implementation Lead - Accounting Solutions (Remote)
EHR Systems Analyst & Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Damien Center \| Health Operations \| Indianapolis, IN
  
  

Full\-Time \| Salaried, Exempt \| $70,000
  
  

Are you the person everyone calls when eClinicalWorks won't cooperate? Do you get a little thrill out of turning a clunky workflow into one that just makes sense? And do you want your tech expertise to directly support care for people living with or at risk for HIV?
  
  

If so, we'd love to meet you. Damien Center is looking for an EHR Systems Analyst \& Support Specialist to be the go\-to expert who keeps our electronic health record running smoothly, helps our teams get the most out of it, and makes sure it works as hard for our patients as our people do.
  
  

Why This Role Matters
  
  

Every appointment, care plan, and follow\-up at Damien Center runs through our EHR. When the system works well, our care teams can spend less time clicking and more time connecting with the people they serve. That's where you come in.
  
  

In this role, you'll be both a trusted helpdesk resource and a strategic partner. You'll troubleshoot day\-to\-day issues, yes, but you'll also shape how our integrated care, quality, and operations teams work, making sure our system supports the reporting and standards that come with being a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) and a Patient\-Centered Medical Home (PCMH). Your work will have a real, visible impact on patient care.
  
  

About Damien Center
  
  

Founded in 1987, Damien Center is Indiana's oldest and largest AIDS service organization, serving more than 8,000 individuals living with or at risk for HIV. We're a trusted partner offering care coordination, integrated care and pharmacy services, mental health, housing, and nutrition, and we're a safe, welcoming home for anyone seeking care.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
  

Keep Our EHR Running Smoothly
  
  

•
  
Serve as the primary helpdesk resource for eClinicalWorks, troubleshooting issues and resolving user concerns
  
  

•
  
Triage, document, and track support requests through to resolution, and escalate to the vendor when needed
  
  

•
  
Manage user accounts, security roles, and access
  
  

•
  
Configure and maintain templates, forms, order sets, alerts, registries, and other workflow tools
  
  

•
  
Help test and roll out software updates and new functionality
  
  

Be Our FQHC \& PCMH Go\-To
  
  

•
  
Act as the organization's expert on how FQHC and PCMH requirements show up in EHR workflows and documentation
  
  

•
  
Make sure eClinicalWorks supports UDS reporting, quality measures, care coordination, preventive and population health, health equity, patient engagement, enabling services, and care gap management
  
  

•
  
Keep an eye on regulatory changes and recommend system updates to stay ahead of them
  
  

Drive Quality \& Continuous Improvement
  
  

•
  
Oversee maintenance of reporting tools and support UDS and quality reporting
  
  

•
  
Spot trends in support requests and turn them into smarter processes
  
  

•
  
Identify opportunities to optimize workflows and participate in quality improvement initiatives
  
  

Teach, Coach \& Empower
  
  

•
  
Develop and deliver eClinicalWorks training, from group sessions to one\-on\-one coaching
  
  

•
  
Lead EHR onboarding for new team members
  
  

•
  
Oversee educational materials and help build standard operating procedures
  
  

Collaborate \& Lead Projects
  
  

•
  
Partner with integrated care, operations, quality, and leadership teams on workflow enhancements
  
  

•
  
Serve as the liaison between end users and the EHR vendor
  
  

•
  
Participate in system implementations, upgrades, testing, and validation
  
  

What You Bring
  
  

Required
  
  

•
  
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, Information Technology, Nursing, Public Health, or a related field\*
  
  

•
  
3\+ years of experience supporting an EHR system in a healthcare setting
  
  

•
  
Hands\-on experience with eClinicalWorks
  
  

•
  
2\+ years of experience in an FQHC, community health center, or primary care environment
  
  

•
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, reporting tools, and healthcare technology systems
  
  

Preferred
  
  

•
  
Experience with PCMH principles and requirements
  
  

•
  
Experience with quality reporting, UDS measures, and population health initiatives
  
  

* Work or lived experience may substitute for education requirements on a case\-by\-case basis.


Who You Are
  
  

•
  
The Translator. You speak both "clinic" and "tech" fluently, and you can explain a system change to a provider, a front desk team member, or a leader in a way that clicks for each of them.
  
  

•
  
The Problem Solver. You enjoy digging into the "why" behind an issue and don't stop at the quick fix when a better solution is within reach.
  
  

•
  
The Patient Teacher. You're comfortable supporting people at every level of tech confidence, and you meet them where they are.
  
  

•
  
The Systems Thinker. You see how one workflow connects to reporting, quality, and ultimately patient care, and you design with the big picture in mind.
  
  

•
  
The Steady Hand. You juggle multiple priorities with organization and calm, work well independently, and handle sensitive information with the highest integrity and confidentiality.
  
  

•
  
The Relationship Builder. You build trust across departments and help create a culture of courtesy, respect, and inclusion.
  
  

Compensation \& Benefits
  
  

**Salary:** $70,000 plus an annual performance\-based salary increase
  
  

•
  
150 hours of PTO in your first year, growing to 195 hours per year after that
  
  

•
  
12 paid holidays
  
  

•
  
Medical coverage with PPO or HDHP options, plus dental and vision
  
  

•
  
HSA or FSA, plus a Dependent Care FSA
  
  

•
  
403(b) retirement plan with 5% match and 100% vesting after 90 days
  
  

•
  
Life insurance at 2x annual salary, plus voluntary life coverage for spouse and children
  
  

•
  
Short\- and long\-term disability
  
  

•
  
Employee Assistance Program and a premium Calm app subscription
  
  

•
  
Tuition assistance and professional development opportunities
  
  

Good to Know
  
  

•
  
This role reports to the Director of IT.
  
  

•
  
This is an office\-based role; remote work may be approved on a case\-by\-case basis.
  
  

•
  
Within your first 90 days, you'll complete four short healthcare IT courses (on us, with certificates provided) covering IT support in healthcare, health IT fundamentals, patient safety, and data security and privacy.
  
  

•
  
As a condition of employment, Damien Center requires an annual flu vaccination and TB test (or chest x\-ray), barring an approved religious or medical exemption.
  
  

Ready to Make an Impact?
  
  

If you're excited about using your EHR expertise to help a mission\-driven team deliver outstanding care, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: DEXIS Regional Clinical Training Specialist (Remote - Greater Phoenix, Arizona)
Training Specialist - Central Ave
jobs.description:
Terros Health is a healthcare organization of caring people, guided by our core values of integrity, compassion and empowerment, with diversity woven throughout. We engage people in whole person health through an integrated care delivery system, thus establishing a medical home for our patients. In caring for the whole person, we focus on overall wellness through physical health, mental health and substance use care. Our mission is to provide extraordinary care by empowered people through exceptional outcomes.




The Training Specialist designs, coordinates, delivers and evaluates training programs. The Training Specialist works to standardize, clarify, and create efficiencies in integrated systems and processes across all Terros Health programs with a specialized focus on clinical training. The Training Specialist partners closely with clinical and operational leaders to support onboarding, ongoing staff development and continuous learning, emphasizing adult learning principles, clarity, and practical application in day\-to\-day work. This position reports to the Manager of Learning and Development.




The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to this classification.




* Supports employees through their transition from new employee orientation to on\-site onboarding, by supporting and coaching new employees, assessing their skills and knowledge, developing customized training plans, growing their competencies and following up to gauge progress to support successful and lasting employment.
* Through an in\-person, competency\-based approach, orients employees to the core functions of their position, including key responsibilities by introducing all tools available, including but not limited to policies, procedures, protocols, training packets, etc.
* Works closely and maintains collaborative relationships with supervisors and site and program leadership to ensure comprehensive and supportive training experience.
* Designs, facilitates, and continuously improves training programs that support Service Excellence standards, clinical workflows, and operational consistency across Terros Health
* Partners closely with clinical and operational teams and internal subject matter experts to assess training needs and translate system changes, policies, and best practices into clear, accessible learning experience, aligning with organizational priorities and expectations
* Supports the rollout of new initiatives, tools, workflows, and service standards by developing and facilitating effective training plans and materials
* Develops and maintains training content, including curricula, facilitator guides, job aids, checklists, and procedural documentation to support consistent practice
* Develop training plans to resolve inefficiencies in areas where improvement is needed. Ensures competency of trainees at the time the training is offered
* Facilitates live and virtual training sessions, workshops, and learning forums, adapting delivery to meet the needs of diverse audiences and programs.
* Facilitates trainings through a variety of learning interventions including, but not limited to, instructor\-led, facilitated, on the job, coaching, 1:1 tutoring and distance learning, to advance a consistent vision, philosophy and approach to mission\-driven, high quality, outcomes focused clinical care.
* Evaluates training effectiveness through feedback, participation data, and observed practice, and recommends adjustments to improve learning outcomes.
* Maintains knowledge about clinical programs and services, program/site workflows, position requirements; and provides ongoing technical support to clinical staff regarding Electronic Health Record.
* Models and reinforces Service Excellence behaviors and expectations in all interactions, training environments, and cross\-functional work
* Maintains training schedules, course records, and reporting within the Relias workforce management platform to ensure accurate tracking and compliance
* Supports workforce engagement initiatives by contributing to learning experiences that strengthen confidence, consistency, and connection to mission
* Develops and maintains a peer relationship through regular meetings, planned events and ad\-hoc activities focused on helping employees make a smooth transition and establish a sense of belonging. Encourages and promotes participation and engagement to facilitate cultural orientation and connection.
* Ensures that training delivered is compliant with state and other contractual obligations and stay current on best practices in adult learning, facilitation, and healthcare training, and apply relevant improvements to training approaches.
* Ensures the smooth and effective functioning of training events for all departments by partnering in the management and coordination of logistics and training systems for training programs and sessions.




**Benefits \& Wellness**


We invest in the health, well\-being, and success of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive benefits, wellness resources, and opportunities to grow both personally and professionally




* Multiple medical plan options, including a no\-premium plan for employees and their families
* Multiple dental plan options, including orthodontic coverage
* Vision insurance
* Group life and disability insurance
* Pet insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Interest\-free medical line of credit
* Financial education, planning, and support resources
* Monetary company contribution toward eligible benefits
* Bilingual pay differential
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) – 3 weeks off in the first year
* Paid Sick Time
* 10 paid holidays annually
* Comprehensive wellness program featuring wellness challenges, activities, and prizes
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) available to employees and their family members
* Trip Reduction Program
* Ongoing professional growth and career development opportunities, including:
	+ Scholarships
	+ Clinical supervision
	+ Continuing Education Units (CEUs)
	+ Tuition discounts through Grand Canyon University, University of Phoenix, and Northern Arizona University (NAU)
* Access to the Working Advantage® Employee Discount Program, with savings on:
	+ Gym memberships
	+ Car rentals
	+ Flights, hotels, movie tickets, and more
* A bachelor's degree in learning and development, education, business administration or in a behavioral health related field
* A minimum of two years of related experience that includes coaching, training or talent management areas; OR equivalent combination of education and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities
* Previous work experience in behavioral health preferred
* Knowledge of training and learning concepts
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
* Experience with development and implementation of training plans and policies and procedures
* Experience in developing and delivering training
* Experience training in the use of Electronic Health Records, such as NextGen
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Highly organized with ability to manage multiple ongoing projects
* Knowledge of clinical best practice documentation standards
* Must have a valid Arizona driver’s license, be 21 years of age with a minimum of 3 years driving experience, and meet requirements of Terros Health’s driving policy
* Must pass a TB/Drug test, and criminal background check




Physical demands of this position are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
